name: Machine Deadlift
steps: Stand between the machine handles with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grasp both handles with your back neutral.
Brace your core and drive firmly through your feet to stand straight up by extending your hips and knees together.
Hinge smoothly back at the hips and bend your knees to lower the handles under control back to the starting stop.
tips: Keep your lower back neutral throughout the lift and avoid leaning backward at lockout.
Keep the handles level as you rise so both legs share the load.
